g.title: data_topology
g.text: Mabtech Payslip — data topology: ONE JSON file owns the entire product state
There is no database engine, no ORM, no migrations, no audit table, no cache, no second copy.

g.title: cluster_writers
g.text: PRIVILEGED CODE — Electron main process is the sole disk accessor

g.title: cluster_memory
g.text: IN-MEMORY STATE (renderer) — volatile, no second store

g.title: cluster_fate
g.text: RETENTION / FAILURE BEHAVIOR (from code, not policy)

g.title: outs
g.text: Nothing links these back to the store

g.title: f4
g.text: Nothing in the code ages out,

g.text: base64 string in the IPC payload
full sheet held in memory as text
